title: Fuxianhuia protensa
summary: Fuxianhuia protensa is an extinct stem-group arthropod from the early Cambrian Chengjiang deposits of Yunnan, China, dated in the sources to 520 million years ago. A 2012 Nature paper reported its preserved brain and optic lobes, which ScienceDaily called the earliest specimen to show a brain.

uncertainty.note: Nature and ScienceDaily give 520 million years ago; UNESCO gives 530 million years for the Chengjiang site generally, so a range of 10 Myr is allowed.

where.modern_name: Chengjiang Fossil Site, Yunnan Province, China (proxy pin: UNESCO property point, not a specimen find spot)
where.historical_name: Shallow Cambrian sea floor on the South China block; no polities exist at this date
